description: This file defines the BankTransfer class for handling bank transfer payment methods within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains logic to determine whether the bank transfer option should be available based on configuration settings, geographic zones, and subscription status, and returns the method details if applicable.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Represents the bank transfer payment method, providing logic to determine its availability based on store configuration and customer location.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines if the bank transfer payment method is available for the given address, returning the method data if available.
